propositions: gerrit-verify.yaml's monolithic build-and-test job hand-copies gate+suite commands that test.yml runs across lint/pip-audit/test jobs, creating manual sync burden and drift risk
test_ci_workflow_parity.py currently polices copy-sync by grep; the invariant should be enforced by construction via a single shared reusable workflow
A new reusable workflow _build-and-test.yml must define lint, pip-audit, and test(matrix) jobs with gerrit-refspec-parameterized checkout (following _optionality.yml pattern) and take no secrets
test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml must both delegate to _build-and-test.yml; gerrit-verify's delegate job remains named build-and-test with unchanged vote dependencies

Five test_ci_workflow_parity.py functions must be rewritten to assert single-source delegation + reusable content (copy-sync check becomes delegation check; pre-commit-SKIP and script-gate safety invariants preserved and retargeted at reusable)
test_workflow_names.py must be updated to cover _build-and-test.yml naming
